title: Garden Plot Renewal
text:
Riverside Community Garden: Plot Renewal Notice

Current gardeners who wish to keep their plots for the coming season must submit a renewal form by February 15. Forms are available in the toolshed or on the garden's website.

Please note that plots showing little activity last season (for example, beds left unweeded for more than three weeks) will not be eligible for automatic renewal. Those gardeners will be placed on the general waiting list instead.

The annual fee remains $30, but members who volunteer at least six hours during the spring cleanup will receive a $10 reduction. Fees are due at the first members' meeting in March.

Questions may be directed to the garden coordinator at the toolshed on Saturday mornings.

title: Museum Pass Program
text:
Oakdale Public Library > Services > Museum Passes

Museum Pass Program
Cardholders can borrow free passes to six local museums, including the Science Discovery Center and the Oakdale Art Gallery. Each pass admits up to four people.

How it works:
• Reserve a pass online up to 30 days in advance.
• Pick up your pass at the front desk on the day before or the day of your visit.
• Return the pass within two days. A $5 late fee is charged for each day it is overdue.

Passes cannot be renewed, and each card may reserve only one pass per month.

title: Campus Bike Share FAQ
text:
Northfield University Transportation > Bike Share > FAQ

How much does it cost?
Rides of up to 45 minutes are included with a semester membership ($25). Each additional 15 minutes costs $1.

Where can I leave a bike?
Bikes must be returned to one of the 14 docking stations on campus. Bikes left elsewhere will be collected by staff, and the rider will be charged a $20 retrieval fee.

What if a bike is damaged?
Use the repair button on the dock to flag the bike before you ride, or report problems in the app. Riders are not held responsible for damage that was reported before their trip began.

Can visitors use the system?
Guests may purchase a day pass at any station kiosk.
